messages.subject: Fetching sources Failed
parts:
Hi,

I am currently working on a R project which requires (among others), the following two packages:

I am using R version 3.0.2 (cannot upgrade since this version is used in our production environment).

I am using Red Hat Enterprise Linux Server release 6.5 (Santiago).

I am using Packrat 0.4.3.

1. When I execute packrat::init(), I get the following error message:

Error in getSourceForPkgRecord(pkgRecord, sourceDir, availablePkgs, repos) :
  Could not find sources for MASS (7.3-37).
Error in getSourceForPkgRecord(pkgRecord, sourceDir, availablePkgs, repos) :
  Could not find sources for PSCBS (0.43.0).
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In FUN(c("PSCBS", "MASS")[[2L]], ...) :

2: In FUN(c("PSCBS", "MASS")[[2L]], ...) :
  Package 'MASS' not available in repository or locally

2. I thought that the 'local repository' option might resolve this error. So I downloaded and unzipped the packages to ~/R/packages:

~/R/packages $ ls
       MASS
       MASS_7.3-37.tar.gz
       PSCBS

And then followed the instructions provided at http://rstudio.github.io/packrat/limitations.html:

Initializing packrat project in directory:

Adding these packages to packrat:

    packrat   0.4.3

Fetching sources for packrat (0.4.3) ... OK (CRAN current)

Installing packrat (0.4.3) ... OK (built source)
Initialization complete!
Packrat mode on. Using library in directory:

> packrat::set_opts(local.repos = "~/R/packages")

> packrat::status()
Up to date.

> packrat::install_local("PSCBS")
Installing package from '~/R/packages/PSCBS'
Installing PSCBS
~/R-3.0.2/lib64/R/bin/R' --vanilla CMD INSTALL  \
  '/home/foo/R/packages/PSCBS'  \
  --library='/home/foo/test2/packrat/lib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/3.0.2'  \
  --install-tests

> packrat::install_local("MASS")
Installing package from '~/R/packages/MASS'
Installing MASS
'~/R-3.0.2/lib64/R/bin/R' --vanilla CMD INSTALL  \
  '/home/foo/R/packages/MASS'  \
  --library='/home/foo/test2/packrat/lib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/3.0.2'  \
  --install-tests

> packrat::status()
Up to date.

> packrat::snapshot()
Adding these packages to packrat:
                _
    DNAcopy       1.36.0
    MASS          7.3-37
    PSCBS         0.43.0
    R.cache       0.10.0
    R.methodsS3   1.7.0
    R.oo          1.19.0
    R.utils       2.0.0
    matrixStats   0.14.0

Fetching sources for MASS (7.3-37) ... Failed
Fetching sources for PSCBS (0.43.0) ... Failed
Error in snapshotSources(project, activeRepos(project), allRecordsFlat) :
  Errors occurred when fetching source files:
Error in getSourceForPkgRecord(pkgRecord, sourceDir, availablePkgs, repos) :
  Could not find sources for MASS (7.3-37).
Error in getSourceForPkgRecord(pkgRecord, sourceDir, availablePkgs, repos) :
  Could not find sources for PSCBS (0.43.0).
>

However, when I execute the packrat::snapshot() command, I am still getting the original error message.

This is my first attempt at using packrat, so any help is greatly appreciated!

Thanks!

Sincerely,
Parin

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Fetching sources Failed
parts:
Hi Parin,

Could you provide your `sessionInfo()` as well? I wonder if the issue here is that:

1. Packrat doesn't properly locate 'oldrel' packages, or
2. Packrat is, for some reason, not finding the appropriate version of MASS in the archives.

It is also possible that the CRAN repository you are using is out of date; perhaps the version of MASS required is not available on its local archives.

Any further information you can provide would be helpful!

Thanks,
Kevin
